$comment: EDE-216 (2026-11-23, #AXC-12): A SHELL DOCUMENT IS EXPRESS. A person's ~/.config/exponential-desktop/ui/<name>.express (the factory copy in /usr/share/exponential-desktop/ui) is ONE Express block (the A2UI inference format, eui-core's `express` feature over the core catalog, #VAPP-294); theme.json stays JSON (a theme, not a surface). WHERE THINGS LIVE, using only what Express already has: (1) the SURFACE HEADER (surface.json) is the `ede` extension of the one surface statement, `surface("<name>", extensions={ede: {layer, anchor, size, exclusiveZone, margin, keyboard, onDemand, popup, functions}})` (A2UI 1.0's createSurface.metadata.extensions.ede), the first statement; its id is the file's name; no other extension, no sendDataModel, no update=true. (2) The DATA MODEL is the `$/path = value` lines (createSurface.dataModel = the document's `data`). (3) The TOP COMPONENT is `root = …` (Express names it root; root's id is `root`); every other component is `<id> = Component(…)` reached from root through children, slots or a template (`children=_template($/rows, row)`: an item no parent names sits inside its owner in the nested form). A component the tree does not reach, or one placed twice, is an issue. (4) NOTES are `#` comments (the compiler drops them; a migrated `$comment` becomes the leading `#` lines, wrapped at 100 chars). Nothing else may stand at the top level (no deleteSurface, no standalone function call). The ONE convention beyond Express: the compiler knows eDE's HOST FUNCTIONS (`hostFunctions`, name → its arguments, all optional) beside the core catalog's, so `ede_lunch(…)` or an unknown argument is a compile error; which of them a document may call is still its surface.functions (Tier C). COMPILE (compileDocument): Express → the document's JSON form {surface: the ede extension, root: the nested tree, data?: the data model}, which surface.json's rules and eui-core's reducer validate exactly as before (validateDocument). ISSUES name the Express line: path `line <l>:<c>` for a syntax error; `line <l> <what>` otherwise, where <what> is `#<id>` (a component's statement: its reducer and Tier C issues, an unknown component, property or function in it), `surface…` (the surface statement: header issues), `data` (the first data line) or `root`; `express` when no statement can be named. An `on` handler written `press=ede_launch(app="x")` compiles to eUI's Action `{functionCall: {@call, args}}`. MIGRATION (one time, #EDE-216): at start the committing runtime turns every `<name>.json` document without a `<name>.express` into Express in ONE commit `Migrate shell documents to Express`: an unedited factory copy (what a `Factory <name>` commit of its .json left, not undone) is dropped and the shipped .express follows as `Factory <name>`; any other is decompiled (decompileDocument: the root's id becomes root, a `style` PROP merges under the node's style, node keys the nested form ignores are dropped, `$schema` is dropped); one that does not convert is set aside as `<name>.json.refused-<version>` with a reset notice. `.json` documents are never read again (the watcher, `exponential-ui set|rm|validate`, git history and the apply machine key on `<name>.express`; `set` still takes a JSON document and writes it as Express). ede-ui (apps/ede/crates/ede-ui, tests/contract.rs) replays every case; the TS reference has no Express compiler and replays none.
